meta.note: A refusal and every eom_class answer is hand-derived; every other expectation comes from an independent brute-force oracle and holds the hand facts of its case. The fixtures are the EOM round's research drafts with a ROLE on every LAW (role table: tpm_eom_check 0.1.0, section 8) and synthetic kernels; test fixtures, not physics under research. T1, T3, T4 and the zone checks are not re-run here: some fixtures are ones the gate refuses, which the notes say. Both residences MUST reproduce every expect. 0.1.1 (agent R4, the cross-check): every fixture tpc_zone 0.5.0 refused that is not refused on purpose now passes it zone by zone: A10a and the synthetic three-variable and per-law PDE kernels declare D_VARIABLES SEVERAL (D177.1); dvar/one-with-two sets ONE explicitly. The fixtures still outside tpc_zone are refused on purpose: the refusal cases, corner_fix_t (a FIXed clock), a CONSTANT as D variable, ONE with two D variables, and the what-is-not-read and switch cases whose TPK or fields are malformed. No expectation moves. 0.1.2 (C-MS-5, increment 11, 2026-09-28): 13 decode/ cases, hand-derived, a JSON {} and [] and an object keyed 0 read as written in both residences; no earlier expectation moves.
